Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Injector

  • Fault: Whilst driving, with the engine warm and under load, the red engine fault light comes on, causing the engine to stall. After the instrument panel is reset, the engine starts again immediately.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0191 (Fuel line pressure sensor – Incorrect setpoint)

  • Cause: Faulty injectors

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the injectors; if necessary, overhaul or replace any that are malfunctioning or defective.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, the return test showed that the first injector from the distributor released significantly more fuel than the other injectors.
    Following the overhaul of the injectors, the problem was definitively resolved.
